claim: NCHAN is DECIMAL 11 — the ROM top index over CHAN0..CHAN11, i.e. twelve sound slots (EFFECT_NAMES.length is 12).

source.verbatim: NCHAN	=11.			;NUMBER OF SOUNDS (SEE CHAN0 THRU CHAN11)

claim: The CHAN table is eight simultaneous sounds spread across two POKEYs.

source.verbatim: CHAN	=.			;TABLE OF 8 SIMULTANEOUS SOUNDS FOR 2 POKEYS

claim: AUDF0 = $400 is the lower POKEY (#0) frequency register.
AUDC0 = $401 is the lower POKEY audio type/amplitude register.
AUDF1 = $800 is the upper POKEY (#1) frequency register.
AUDC1 = $801 is the upper POKEY audio type/amplitude register.
SOUNDS is the sound routine, run per frame over all channels of both POKEYs.
SOUNDS walks NCHAN channels (the driver iterates all twelve slots).
Each slot's MASK byte is loaded to gate its update cadence.
The MASK is ANDed with the interrupt counter INTCT.
When (MASK & INTCT) is non-zero the slot is skipped this interrupt (so shouldTick fires only when it is zero).
The slot index is compared against 8 to choose the POKEY.
Index below 8 uses the LOWER POKEY (#0); 8 and above uses the upper — the pokeyOf split.
The frequency table is stored in the OPPOSITE order it is written to POKEY, so play order is the stored table reversed.

source.verbatim: ;	IS IN THE OPPOSITE ORDER WRITTEN

claim: A stored table value of zero means turn the volume off (a rest); the opposite-order rule continues here.

source.verbatim: ;	TO THE POKEY.  A TABLE VALUE OF ZERO MEANS

claim: MASK is the per-slot frame-mask table controlling the speed of the sounds.

source.verbatim: MASK:	.BYTE 3,1,3,7		;FRAME MASK TO CONTROL SPEED OF SOUNDS

claim: The FREQ pointer table begins with slot 0 (BEETLE); each entry is a table-minus-one address or a constant.
Slot 4 (dragonfly) has a 0 FREQ pointer — the program stuffs POKEY directly, so freqSweep(4) is empty.
The CONT (volume/control) pointer table parallels FREQ.
Slot 6 (shot) has a CONSTANT CONT value 0x68, not a table — contSweep(6) holds one volume while the pitch falls.
FREQ2 is the EXPLOSION frequency table (its descending F0->10 body is the bang).
CONT2 is the explosion volume ramp (played reversed it is a loud attack decaying to silence).
FREQ10 is the PLAYER-EXPLOSION frequency table, a clean 50->02 fall.
